blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Debugging is a method, not luck. Work out the kind of bug, make it happen every time, narrow down where it starts, change one thing and test again. The compiler, prints, a debugger and asserts are your tools.

blocks.title: Kinds of bugs
items: Syntax: compiler stops, message with line
Logic: runs, wrong answer, no message

blocks.title: Debugger commands
items: `break main` or `b main`: pause at main
`print x` or `p x`: show a value

blocks.body: Fix the first error first, and print with labels like `i=%d`.
